==================== CHUNK 11 (model) ====================
[Anilili](https://github.com/kompoti121/anilili) [1.1] is a native Android/Android TV open-source client. It combines **AniList/MyAnimeList metadata and progress tracking** with **multi-source anime stream resolvers**, a **Material 3 UI**, and **smart playback tools (AniSkip, sub/dub switching, multi-server failover)** [1.10, 1.19].

To build a modern web application inspired by Anilili, here is a complete architectural blueprint, tech stack breakdown, and implementation guide.

---

### 1. Architectural Overview of Anilili

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Frontend / UI Layer                  │
│  (Hero Banner, Airing Schedule, Details, Player UI)    │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────────┬──────────────┘
               │                          │
      ┌────────▼─────────┐       ┌────────▼─────────┐
      │  Metadata Layer  │       │  Playback Layer  │
      │  (AniList / MAL) │       │  (Hls.js, Skip)  │
      └────────┬─────────┘       └────────┬─────────┘
               │                          │
┌──────────────▼──────────────────────────▼──────────────┐
│                   Backend / API Layer                  │
│ • AniList GraphQL Proxy & Auth (OAuth2)                │
│ • Stream Aggregator (Miruro / Consumet / Anivexa APIs) │
│ • AniSkip Endpoint (`api.aniskip.com`)                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Recommended Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Framework** | **Next.js 14+ (App Router)** or **Vite + React** | Server-side rendering (SEO) for anime titles, fast client-side navigation |
| **Styling** | **Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Lucide React** | Dark-mode Netflix/Crunchyroll-style aesthetic, smooth layout transitions |
| **Video Player** | **Hls.js** or **Video.js** / **Media Chrome** | Custom-skinned HLS stream player with adaptive bitrate (1080p, 720p, 480p) |
| **Metadata API** | **AniList GraphQL API** (Free, no key needed for public data) | Anime info, season charts, airing schedules, character data |
| **Skip Timestamps**| **AniSkip API** (`api.aniskip.com`) | Auto/one-click Intro (OP) and Outro (ED) skipping |
| **State & Sync** | **Zustand** + **Local Storage / IndexedDB** | Watch progress, volume, subtitle preferences, watch history |

### 3. Core Features to Implement

1. **Discovery & Exploration**:
   - Hero spotlight carousel with backdrop artwork, trailer preview modal, and genre tags.
   - Categorized shelves: *Trending Now*, *Popular This Season*, *Top Rated*, and *Airing Schedule* (Day-by-day calendar).
   - Advanced search with fuzzy filtering by genre, format (TV/Movie/OVA), year, and studio.

2. **Anime Detail & Episode Hub**:
   - Synopsis, status, countdown to next episode airing.
   - Grid/list selector for episodes with thumbnails, titles, and filler episode indicators.
   - Character cast & voice actors list, franchise relations timeline, and recommendations.

3. **Advanced Video Player (Anilili-grade UX)**:
   - **Multi-Source & Multi-Server Selector**: Primary stream with automatic fallback servers.
   - **Sub / Dub Toggle**: Direct switching between Japanese audio (with subtitle tracks) and English dubs.
   - **AniSkip Integration**: Detects Opening (OP) and Ending (ED) timestamps to display an on-screen "Skip Intro" button or auto-skip.
   - **Playlist Drawer**: Next / Previous episode shortcuts and auto-play countdown.
   - **Keyboard Shortcuts & Fullscreen / PiP Controls**: Space (Play/Pause), Left/Right (Seek 5s), 'F' (Fullscreen), 'S' (Skip Intro).

4. **User Sync & Progress Tracking**:
   - Local progress storage (resume playback at exact timestamps).
   - Optional AniList / MyAnimeList OAuth to synchronize watch statuses (*Watching*, *Completed*, *Plan to Watch*).

### 4. Code Blueprints

#### A. Fetching Anime Metadata via AniList GraphQL
AniList provides a GraphQL API without requiring an API key for queries:

```typescript
// lib/anilist.ts
const ANILIST_API = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';

export async function getTrendingAnime(page = 1, perPage = 10) {
  const query = `
    query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int) {
      Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
        media(type: ANIME, sort: TRENDING_DESC) {
          id
          title {
            romaji
            english
            native
          }
          bannerImage
          coverImage {
            large
            extraLarge
          }
          description
          episodes
          genres
          averageScore
          nextAiringEpisode {
            episode
            airingAt
          }
        }
      }
    }
  `;

  const res = await fetch(ANILIST_API, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables: { page, perPage } }),
    next: { revalidate: 3600 }, // Cache for 1 hour in Next.js
  });

  const data = await res.json();
  return data.data.Page.media;
}
```

---

#### B. AniSkip Integration (Skip Intro / Outro)
Anilili uses AniSkip timestamps to automatically skip OPs and EDs [1.10]:

```typescript
// lib/aniskip.ts
export interface SkipTimestamp {
  interval: {
    startTime: number;
    endTime: number;
  };
  skipType: 'op' | 'ed' | 'mixed-op' | 'mixed-ed' | 'recap';
}

export async function fetchSkipTimestamps(
  malId: number,
  episodeNumber: number,
  episodeLength = 0
): Promise<SkipTimestamp[]> {
  const url = `https://api.aniskip.com/v2/skip-times/${malId}/${episodeNumber}?types[]=op&types[]=ed&types[]=recap&episodeLength=${episodeLength}`;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const data = await res.json();
    return data.results || [];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load AniSkip timestamps:', error);
    return [];
  }
}
```

---

#### C. Custom Video Player with HLS & Skip Controls (React / Next.js)

```tsx
// components/AnimePlayer.tsx
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Hls from 'hls.js';

interface PlayerProps {
  streamUrl: string; // m3u8 playlist or direct video
  opStartTime?: number;
  opEndTime?: number;
  onEnded?: () => void;
}

export function AnimePlayer({ streamUrl, opStartTime, opEndTime, onEnded }: PlayerProps) {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const [showSkipButton, setShowSkipButton] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return;

    if (Hls.isSupported() && streamUrl.endsWith('.m3u8')) {
      const hls = new Hls({ enableWorker: true });
      hls.loadSource(streamUrl);
      hls.attachMedia(video);
      return () => hls.destroy();
    } else {
      video.src = streamUrl;
    }
  }, [streamUrl]);

  const handleTimeUpdate = () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !opStartTime || !opEndTime) return;

    // Check if current time is within OP/ED range
    if (video.currentTime >= opStartTime && video.currentTime < opEndTime) {
      setShowSkipButton(true);
    } else {
      setShowSkipButton(false);
    }
  };

  const skipIntro = () => {
    if (videoRef.current && opEndTime) {
      videoRef.current.currentTime = opEndTime;
      setShowSkipButton(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-black shadow-2xl">
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        controls
        className="h-full w-full"
        onTimeUpdate={handleTimeUpdate}
        onEnded={onEnded}
      />
      {showSkipButton && (
        <button
          onClick={skipIntro}
          className="absolute bottom-20 right-6 z-20 rounded-lg bg-white/20 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white backdrop-blur-md transition hover:bg-white hover:text-black"
        >
          Skip Intro ⏭
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 2. The "Must-Have" Features (What Makes Anilili Great)

To make your website look professional and stand out, prioritize these core features:

1. **AniSkip (Skip Intro / Outro Button)**:
   - Users love one-click skipping for Opening and Ending songs. We connect this to the free `api.aniskip.com` database.
2. **Multi-Server Failover**:
   - If one video link buffers or goes down, having buttons for **Server 1 (HD)**, **Server 2**, and **Server 3** ensures playback never breaks.
3. **Sub / Dub Audio Switcher**:
   - A toggle allowing users to choose between Japanese with subtitles or English dubbing.
4. **"Continue Watching" Resume Bar**:
   - Automatically remembers where the user left off (saved directly in the browser's storage).
5. **A Clean, Dark "Glassmorphism" UI**:
   - High-resolution banners, glowing accents, and no clutter.

```html
        <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514539079130-25950c84af65?q=80&w=400" class="w-full aspect-[3/4] object-cover rounded-lg" />

  <script>
    const video = document.getElementById('videoPlayer');
    const skipBtn = document.getElementById('skipIntroBtn');

    function playAnime(title, videoUrl) {
      document.getElementById('playerSection').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('nowPlayingTitle').innerText = title + ' - Episode 1';
      video.src = videoUrl;
      video.play();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 150, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function closePlayer() {
      video.pause();
      document.getElementById('playerSection').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Auto-show Skip Intro button during intro
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
      if (video.currentTime >= 2 && video.currentTime <= 20) {
        skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    });

    function skipIntro() {
      video.currentTime = 21;
      skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    function renderGrids() {
      const trending = ANIME_DATABASE.filter(a => a.category === 'trending' || a.category === 'top');
      const top = ANIME_DATABASE.filter(a => a.category === 'top' || a.score >= 8.8);

      document.getElementById('topRatedGrid').innerHTML = top.map(createCardHTML).join('');
      document.getElementById('seasonalGrid').innerHTML = seasonal.map(createCardHTML).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function createCardHTML(anime) {
      return `
        <div onclick="showDetails(${anime.id})" class="group cursor-pointer rounded-xl bg-dark-card border border-dark-border/80 overflow-hidden hover:border-brand-500/60 hover:-translate-y-1.5 transition duration-300 shadow-md">
          <div class="relative aspect-[3/4] overflow-hidden">

            <div class="absolute top-2 left-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md text-[10px] font-bold text-yellow-400 flex items-center gap-0.5">

            <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 truncate mt-0.5">${anime.genres.join(' • ')}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderContinueWatching() {
      const section = document.getElementById('continueWatchingSection');
      const grid = document.getElementById('continueWatchingGrid');
      
      if (watchHistory.length === 0) {
        section.classList.add('hidden');
        return;

      section.classList.remove('hidden');

            </div>
            <div class="space-y-1">
              <div class="w-full h-1.5 bg-dark-card rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                <div class="h-full bg-brand-500" style="width: ${item.progress || 65}%"></div>
              </div>

                <i data-lucide="play" class="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-brand-400"></i> Resume

    function showDetails(animeId) {
      const anime = ANIME_DATABASE.find(a => a.id === animeId);
      if (!anime) return;
      currentModalAnime = anime;

      document.getElementById('modalBanner').style.backgroundImage = `url('${anime.banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('modalCover').src = anime.cover;
      document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = anime.title;
      document.getElementById('modalScore').innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="star" class="w-3 h-3 fill-yellow-400"></i> ${anime.score}`;
      document.getElementById('modalEpisodes').textContent = `${anime.episodes} Episodes`;
      document.getElementById('modalStatus').textContent = anime.status;
      document.getElementById('modalGenres').textContent = anime.genres.join(' • ');
      document.getElementById('modalDescription').textContent = anime.description;

      document.getElementById('modalPlayBtn').onclick = () => {
        closeDetailModal();
        launchPlayer(anime.id, 1);
      };

      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.remove('hidden');
      lucide.createIcons();

    function closeDetailModal() {
      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Launch Hero Spotlight Player
    function launchHeroPlayer() {
      launchPlayer(currentHeroAnime.id, 1);
    }

    // Launch Video Player
    function launchPlayer(animeId, episodeNum = 1) {
      const anime = ANIME_DATABASE.find(a => a.id === animeId);
      if (!anime) return;
      currentPlayingAnime = anime;
      currentEpisodeNum = episodeNum;

      document.getElementById('playerAnimeTitle').textContent = `${anime.title} - Episode ${episodeNum}`;
      document.getElementById('totalEpCount').textContent = anime.episodes;

      // Populate Episode Grid in Player Drawer
      const epGrid = document.getElementById('episodeGrid');
      let epHTML = '';
      for (let i = 1; i <= anime.episodes; i++) {
        const isCurrent = i === episodeNum;
        epHTML += `
          <button onclick="changeEpisode(${i})" class="py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${isCurrent ? 'bg-brand-600 text-white' : 'bg-dark-card text-slate-300 hover:bg-dark-border'} border border-dark-border transition">
            ${i}
          </button>
        `;
      }
      epGrid.innerHTML = epHTML;

      // Record to Watch History
      addToHistory(anime, episodeNum);

      // Open Modal & Play
      const modal = document.getElementById('playerModal');
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');

      const video = document.getElementById('mainVideo');
      video.play().catch(e => console.log('Autoplay handled:', e));
    }

    function closePlayerModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('playerModal');
      const video = document.getElementById('mainVideo');
      video.pause();
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      cancelAutoNext();
    }

    function changeEpisode(epNum) {
      launchPlayer(currentPlayingAnime.id, epNum);
    }

    // AniSkip & Playback Timestamps simulation
    function initVideoEvents() {
      const video = document.getElementById('mainVideo');
      const aniSkipBtn = document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn');

      video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
        // Mock OP timestamp: between 5s and 25s
        if (video.currentTime >= 5 && video.currentTime <= 25) {
          aniSkipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          aniSkipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });

      video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
        startAutoNextCountdown();
      });
    }

    function triggerAniSkip() {
      const video = document.getElementById('mainVideo');
      video.currentTime = 26; // Skip past OP
      document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function startAutoNextCountdown() {
      if (!currentPlayingAnime || currentEpisodeNum >= currentPlayingAnime.episodes) return;
      const overlay = document.getElementById('nextEpCountdown');
      overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
      let sec = 5;
      document.getElementById('countdownSec').textContent = sec;

      autoNextTimer = setInterval(() => {
        sec--;
        document.getElementById('countdownSec').textContent = sec;
        if (sec <= 0) {
          clearInterval(autoNextTimer);
          playNextEpisodeImmediately();
        }
      }, 1000);
    }

    function cancelAutoNext() {
      if (autoNextTimer) clearInterval(autoNextTimer);
      document.getElementById('nextEpCountdown').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function playNextEpisodeImmediately() {
      cancelAutoNext();
      launchPlayer(currentPlayingAnime.id, currentEpisodeNum + 1);
    }

    function switchServer(serverName) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.server-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('bg-brand-600', 'text-white', 'border-brand-500');
        btn.classList.add('bg-dark-card', 'text-slate-300', 'border-dark-border');
      });
      const active = document.getElementById(`srv-${serverName}`);
      if (active) {
        active.classList.add('bg-brand-600', 'text-white', 'border-brand-500');
        active.classList.remove('bg-dark-card', 'text-slate-300', 'border-dark-border');
      }
    }

    function toggleAudio(audioType) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.audio-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('bg-brand-600', 'text-white', 'border-brand-500');
        btn.classList.add('bg-dark-card', 'text-slate-300', 'border-dark-border');
      });
      const active = document.getElementById(`audio-${audioType}`);
      if (active) {
        active.classList.add('bg-brand-600', 'text-white', 'border-brand-500');
        active.classList.remove('bg-dark-card', 'text-slate-300', 'border-dark-border');
      }
    }

    function addToHistory(anime, episode) {
      watchHistory = watchHistory.filter(h => h.animeId !== anime.id);
      watchHistory.unshift({
        animeId: anime.id,
        title: anime.title,
        cover: anime.cover,
        episode: episode,
        progress: 45
      });
      localStorage.setItem('anilili_history', JSON.stringify(watchHistory));
      renderContinueWatching();
    }

    // Watchlist Management
    function toggleBookmarkCurrentModal() {
      if (!currentModalAnime) return;
      const index = watchlist.findIndex(w => w.id === currentModalAnime.id);
      if (index > -1) {
        watchlist.splice(index, 1);
      } else {
        watchlist.push(currentModalAnime);
      }
      localStorage.setItem('anilili_watchlist', JSON.stringify(watchlist));
      updateWatchlistBadge();
      renderWatchlist();
      closeDetailModal();
    }

    function updateWatchlistBadge() {
      document.getElementById('watchlistCountBadge').textContent = watchlist.length;
    }

    function toggleWatchlistModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('watchlistModal');
      modal.classList.toggle('hidden');
      if (!modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        renderWatchlist();
      }
    }

    function renderWatchlist() {
      const container = document.getElementById('watchlistContainer');
      if (watchlist.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 py-8 text-center">Your watchlist is currently empty.</p>';
        return;
      }
      container.innerHTML = watchlist.map(anime => `
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-dark-card border border-dark-border">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <img src="${anime.cover}" class="w-12 h-16 object-cover rounded-lg" />
            <div>
              <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-white">${anime.title}</h4>
              <span class="text-[10px] text-yellow-400 font-semibold">★ ${anime.score}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onclick="launchPlayer(${anime.id}, 1); toggleWatchlistModal();" class="p-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 text-white">
            <i data-lucide="play" class="w-4 h-4 fill-white"></i>
          </button>
        </div>
      `).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function clearWatchlist() {
      watchlist = [];
      localStorage.setItem('anilili_watchlist', JSON.stringify(watchlist));
      updateWatchlistBadge();
      renderWatchlist();
    }

    // Airing Schedule Modal
    function toggleScheduleModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('scheduleModal');
      modal.classList.toggle('hidden');
      if (!modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        renderSchedule();
      }
    }

    function renderSchedule() {
      const days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
      document.getElementById('scheduleDays').innerHTML = days.map((day, idx) => `
        <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-dark-card border border-dark-border">
          <h4 class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand-400 mb-2">${day}</h4>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-200">
            <span>${ANIME_DATABASE[idx % ANIME_DATABASE.length].title}</span>
            <span class="text-slate-400 font-mono">18:00 JST (EP ${idx + 2})</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    // Instant Search
    function handleSearch(query) {
      if (!query.trim()) {
        renderGrids();
        return;
      }
      const filtered = ANIME_DATABASE.filter(a => 
        a.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) || 
        a.romaji.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
        a.genres.some(g => g.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
      );
      document.getElementById('trendingGrid').innerHTML = filtered.map(createCardHTML).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // AniList Mock Sync Action
    function mockAniListSync() {
      const icon = document.getElementById('syncIcon');
      const text = document.getElementById('syncText');
      icon.classList.add('animate-spin');
      text.textContent = 'Syncing...';

      setTimeout(() => {
        icon.classList.remove('animate-spin');
        text.textContent = 'Synced with AniList';
        setTimeout(() => {
          text.textContent = 'AniList Sync';
        }, 3000);
      }, 1200);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

   - **Real-Time AniList Account Sync**: Tap the **AniList Sync** button in the header, enter your AniList username, and it will load your library (*Watching*, *Completed*, *Planning*) with real ratings and status.

4. **Built-in Anilili Video Player & AniSkip**:
   - Tapping any anime opens the detail card, video player, and "Skip Intro (AniSkip)" button.

```html
  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    const ANILIST_ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';
    let currentAnimeInModal = null;
    let myAnimeList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('anilove_mylist') || '[]');

    // 1. Theme Controller (Dark / Light Mode)
    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('anilove_theme') || 'light';
      if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !isDark);
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // 2. Real-Time AniList GraphQL Queries
    async function queryAniList(query, variables) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(ANILIST_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.data;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('AniList API Error:', err);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const CATALOG_QUERY = `
      query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $sort: [MediaSort], $season: MediaSeason, $seasonYear: Int, $search: String, $genre: String) {
        Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
          media(type: ANIME, sort: $sort, season: $season, seasonYear: $seasonYear, search: $search, genre: $genre, isAdult: false) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
              native
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
              large
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            status
            episodes
            genres
            description
          }
        }
      }
    `;

    async function loadHomePageData() {
      // 1. Trending Now
      const trendingData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['TRENDING_DESC']
      });
      if (trendingData && trendingData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('trendingGrid', trendingData.Page.media);
      }

      // 2. Airing in Summer 2026 (or dynamic current year/season)
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const seasonalData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        season: 'SUMMER',
        seasonYear: currentYear,
        sort: ['POPULARITY_DESC']
      });
      if (seasonalData && seasonalData.Page.media) {
        document.getElementById('seasonHeading').textContent = `Airing in Summer ${currentYear}`;
        renderCardGrid('seasonalGrid', seasonalData.Page.media);
      }

      // 3. Top Rated of All Time
      const topData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['SCORE_DESC']
      });
      if (topData && topData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('topRatedGrid', topData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    function renderCardGrid(elementId, animeList) {
      const container = document.getElementById(elementId);
      if (!container) return;

      if (!animeList || animeList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No series found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = animeList.map(anime => {
        const title = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Untitled';
        const score = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A';
        const year = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate ? anime.startDate.year : '2026');
        const format = anime.format || 'TV';
        const cover = anime.coverImage.large || anime.coverImage.extraLarge;

        return `
          <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${anime.id})" class="anime-card group cursor-pointer flex flex-col space-y-2.5">
            <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 dark:bg-dark-card shadow-sm border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-dark-border">
              <img src="${cover}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" class="anime-card-img w-full h-full object-cover" />
              <div class="rating-badge absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/60 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm">
                <span class="text-yellow-400 font-normal">☆</span> ${score}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-brand-600 transition">
                ${title}
              </h3>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                ${format} · ${year}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function showTab(tabName) {
      document.getElementById('homeTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'home');
      document.getElementById('browseTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'browse');
      document.getElementById('myListTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'mylist');
      document.getElementById('heroSection').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName === 'mylist');

      const tabs = ['home', 'browse', 'mylist'];
      tabs.forEach(t => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`nav-${t}`);
        if (t === tabName) {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-dark-surface text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-semibold transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition";
        }
      });

      if (tabName === 'browse') {
        applyFilters();
      } else if (tabName === 'mylist') {
        renderMyList('all');
      }
    }

    async function triggerSearch() {
      const query = document.getElementById('heroSearchInput').value.trim();
      if (!query) return;
      showTab('browse');
      document.getElementById('browseTitle').textContent = `Search results for "${query}"`;
      
      const searchData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        search: query
      });

      if (searchData && searchData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', searchData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function applyFilters() {
      const genre = document.getElementById('genreFilter').value || undefined;
      const sort = [document.getElementById('sortFilter').value || 'POPULARITY_DESC'];

      const data = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        genre: genre,
        sort: sort
      });

      if (data && data.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', data.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function openAnimeDetails(animeId) {
      const query = `
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            status
            episodes
            genres
            description(asHtml: false)
          }
        }
      `;
      const res = await queryAniList(query, { id: animeId });
      if (!res || !res.Media) return;
      const anime = res.Media;
      currentAnimeInModal = anime;

      document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji;
      document.getElementById('detailScore').textContent = `☆ ${anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}`;
      document.getElementById('detailFormat').textContent = `${anime.format || 'TV'} • ${anime.seasonYear || '2026'}`;
      document.getElementById('detailStatus').textContent = anime.status || 'FINISHED';
      document.getElementById('detailGenres').textContent = (anime.genres || []).join(' • ');
      document.getElementById('detailSynopsis').textContent = anime.description ? anime.description.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '') : 'No synopsis available.';

      const banner = anime.bannerImage || anime.coverImage.extraLarge;
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').style.backgroundImage = `url('${banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer').pause();

      const found = myAnimeList.find(x => x.id === anime.id);
      document.getElementById('userStatusSelect').value = found ? found.status : 'UNTRACKED';

      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.remove('hidden');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function closeDetailModal() {
      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.add('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.pause();
    }

    function startVideoPlayback() {
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').classList.add('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.src = "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4";
      vid.classList.remove('hidden');
      vid.play();

      const skipBtn = document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn');
      vid.ontimeupdate = () => {
        if (vid.currentTime >= 3 && vid.currentTime <= 25) {
          skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      };
    }

    function triggerAniSkip() {
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.currentTime = 26;
      document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function updateWatchStatus(status) {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      myAnimeList = myAnimeList.filter(x => x.id !== currentAnimeInModal.id);
      if (status !== 'UNTRACKED') {
        myAnimeList.push({
          id: currentAnimeInModal.id,
          title: currentAnimeInModal.title,
          coverImage: currentAnimeInModal.coverImage,
          averageScore: currentAnimeInModal.averageScore,
          format: currentAnimeInModal.format,
          seasonYear: currentAnimeInModal.seasonYear,
          status: status
        });
      }
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
      updateMyListBadge();
    }

    function updateMyListBadge() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('myListBadge');
      if (myAnimeList.length > 0) {
        badge.textContent = myAnimeList.length;
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        badge.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    function renderMyList(filterStatus = 'all') {
      const container = document.getElementById('myListGrid');
      const list = filterStatus === 'all' ? myAnimeList : myAnimeList.filter(x => x.status === filterStatus);
      renderCardGrid('myListGrid', list);
    }

    function filterMyList(status) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.list-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-dark-card text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 list-filter-btn";
      });
      document.getElementById(`lfb-${status}`).className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-brand-600 text-white font-semibold list-filter-btn";
      renderMyList(status);
    }

    function openAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function syncRealAniListUser() {
      const username = document.getElementById('anilistUsernameInput').value.trim();
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('syncResultStatus');
      const syncBtn = document.getElementById('doSyncBtn');

      if (!username) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Please enter your AniList username';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetching from AniList...';
      syncBtn.disabled = true;

      const userListQuery = `
        query ($userName: String) {
          MediaListCollection(userName: $userName, type: ANIME) {
            lists {
              name
              status
              entries {
                status
                score
                media {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    extraLarge
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                  format
                  seasonYear
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const result = await queryAniList(userListQuery, { userName: username });
        if (result && result.MediaListCollection && result.MediaListCollection.lists) {
          const syncedItems = [];
          result.MediaListCollection.lists.forEach(list => {
            list.entries.forEach(entry => {
              syncedItems.push({
                id: entry.media.id,
                title: entry.media.title,
                coverImage: entry.media.coverImage,
                averageScore: entry.media.averageScore,
                format: entry.media.format,
                seasonYear: entry.media.seasonYear,
                status: entry.status || 'CURRENT'
              });
            });
          });

          myAnimeList = syncedItems;
          localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
          updateMyListBadge();

          document.getElementById('anilistBtnLabel').textContent = `@${username}`;
          statusEl.textContent = `✓ Synced ${syncedItems.length} anime from @${username}!`;
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');

          setTimeout(() => {
            closeAniListModal();
            syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
            syncBtn.disabled = false;
            statusEl.classList.add('hidden');
          }, 1800);
        } else {
          statusEl.textContent = 'User not found or list is private on AniList.';
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
          syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
          syncBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Failed to connect to AniList API.';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
        syncBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      initTheme();
      lucide.createIcons();
      updateMyListBadge();
      loadHomePageData();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- Detail Information -->
      <div class="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
          <div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <span id="detailScore" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 text-xs font-bold">☆ 9.0</span>
              <span id="detailFormat" class="text-xs text-slate-400">TV • 2026</span>
              <span id="detailStatus" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-semibold">RELEASING</span>
            </div>
            <h3 id="detailTitle" class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-white">Anime Title</h3>
          </div>

          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <select id="userStatusSelect" onchange="updateWatchStatus(this.value)" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-dark-card border border-dark-border text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
              <option value="UNTRACKED">+ Add to My List</option>
              <option value="CURRENT">Watching</option>
              <option value="COMPLETED">Completed</option>
              <option value="PLANNING">Planning to Watch</option>
              <option value="DROPPED">Dropped</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p id="detailGenres" class="text-xs font-bold text-brand-600"></p>
        <p id="detailSynopsis" class="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed"></p>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ================= FOOTER ================= -->
  <footer class="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 border-t border-dark-border/40 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
    <p>Anilove · Anime data from the AniList API. Not affiliated with AniList or MyAnimeList.</p>
  </footer>

  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    const ANILIST_ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';
    let currentAnimeInModal = null;
    let myAnimeList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('anilove_mylist') || '[]');

    // 1. Theme Controller (Default: Dark Mode)
    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('anilove_theme') || 'dark';
      if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !isDark);
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // 2. Real-Time AniList GraphQL Queries
    async function queryAniList(query, variables) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(ANILIST_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.data;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('AniList API Error:', err);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const CATALOG_QUERY = `
      query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $sort: [MediaSort], $season: MediaSeason, $seasonYear: Int, $search: String, $genre: String) {
        Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
          media(type: ANIME, sort: $sort, season: $season, seasonYear: $seasonYear, search: $search, genre: $genre, isAdult: false) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
              native
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
              large
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            status
            episodes
            genres
            description
          }
        }
      }
    `;

    async function loadHomePageData() {
      // 1. Trending Now
      const trendingData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['TRENDING_DESC']
      });
      if (trendingData && trendingData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('trendingGrid', trendingData.Page.media);
      }

      // 2. Airing in Summer 2026
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const seasonalData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        season: 'SUMMER',
        seasonYear: currentYear,
        sort: ['POPULARITY_DESC']
      });
      if (seasonalData && seasonalData.Page.media) {
        document.getElementById('seasonHeading').textContent = `Airing in Summer ${currentYear}`;
        renderCardGrid('seasonalGrid', seasonalData.Page.media);
      }

      // 3. Top Rated of All Time
      const topData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['SCORE_DESC']
      });
      if (topData && topData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('topRatedGrid', topData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    function renderCardGrid(elementId, animeList) {
      const container = document.getElementById(elementId);
      if (!container) return;

      if (!animeList || animeList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No series found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = animeList.map(anime => {
        const title = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Untitled';
        const score = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A';
        const year = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate ? anime.startDate.year : '2026');
        const format = anime.format || 'TV';
        const cover = anime.coverImage.large || anime.coverImage.extraLarge;

        return `
          <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${anime.id})" class="anime-card group cursor-pointer flex flex-col space-y-2.5">
            <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-dark-card shadow-md border border-dark-border/80">
              <img src="${cover}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" class="anime-card-img w-full h-full object-cover" />
              <div class="rating-badge absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/70 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 border border-white/10 shadow-sm">
                <span class="text-yellow-400 font-normal">☆</span> ${score}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-brand-600 transition">
                ${title}
              </h3>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                ${format} · ${year}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function showTab(tabName) {
      document.getElementById('homeTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'home');
      document.getElementById('browseTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'browse');
      document.getElementById('myListTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'mylist');
      document.getElementById('heroSection').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName === 'mylist');

      const tabs = ['home', 'browse', 'mylist'];
      tabs.forEach(t => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`nav-${t}`);
        if (t === tabName) {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-dark-card border border-dark-border text-white font-semibold transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition";
        }
      });

      if (tabName === 'browse') {
        applyFilters();
      } else if (tabName === 'mylist') {
        renderMyList('all');
      }
    }

    async function triggerSearch() {
      const query = document.getElementById('heroSearchInput').value.trim();
      if (!query) return;
      showTab('browse');
      document.getElementById('browseTitle').textContent = `Search results for "${query}"`;
      
      const searchData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        search: query
      });

      if (searchData && searchData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', searchData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function applyFilters() {
      const genre = document.getElementById('genreFilter').value || undefined;
      const sort = [document.getElementById('sortFilter').value || 'POPULARITY_DESC'];

      const data = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        genre: genre,
        sort: sort
      });

      if (data && data.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', data.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function openAnimeDetails(animeId) {
      const query = `
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            status
            episodes
            genres
            description(asHtml: false)
          }
        }
      `;
      const res = await queryAniList(query, { id: animeId });
      if (!res || !res.Media) return;
      const anime = res.Media;
      currentAnimeInModal = anime;

      document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji;
      document.getElementById('detailScore').textContent = `☆ ${anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}`;
      document.getElementById('detailFormat').textContent = `${anime.format || 'TV'} • ${anime.seasonYear || '2026'}`;
      document.getElementById('detailStatus').textContent = anime.status || 'FINISHED';
      document.getElementById('detailGenres').textContent = (anime.genres || []).join(' • ');
      document.getElementById('detailSynopsis').textContent = anime.description ? anime.description.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '') : 'No synopsis available.';

      const banner = anime.bannerImage || anime.coverImage.extraLarge;
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').style.backgroundImage = `url('${banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer').pause();

      const found = myAnimeList.find(x => x.id === anime.id);
      document.getElementById('userStatusSelect').value = found ? found.status : 'UNTRACKED';

      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.remove('hidden');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function closeDetailModal() {
      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.add('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.pause();
    }

    function startVideoPlayback() {
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').classList.add('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.src = "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4";
      vid.classList.remove('hidden');
      vid.play();

      const skipBtn = document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn');
      vid.ontimeupdate = () => {
        if (vid.currentTime >= 3 && vid.currentTime <= 25) {
          skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      };
    }

    function triggerAniSkip() {
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.currentTime = 26;
      document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function updateWatchStatus(status) {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      myAnimeList = myAnimeList.filter(x => x.id !== currentAnimeInModal.id);
      if (status !== 'UNTRACKED') {
        myAnimeList.push({
          id: currentAnimeInModal.id,
          title: currentAnimeInModal.title,
          coverImage: currentAnimeInModal.coverImage,
          averageScore: currentAnimeInModal.averageScore,
          format: currentAnimeInModal.format,
          seasonYear: currentAnimeInModal.seasonYear,
          status: status
        });
      }
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
      updateMyListBadge();
    }

    function updateMyListBadge() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('myListBadge');
      if (myAnimeList.length > 0) {
        badge.textContent = myAnimeList.length;
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        badge.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    function renderMyList(filterStatus = 'all') {
      const container = document.getElementById('myListGrid');
      const list = filterStatus === 'all' ? myAnimeList : myAnimeList.filter(x => x.status === filterStatus);
      renderCardGrid('myListGrid', list);
    }

    function filterMyList(status) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.list-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-dark-card border border-dark-border text-slate-300 list-filter-btn";
      });
      document.getElementById(`lfb-${status}`).className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-brand-600 text-white font-semibold list-filter-btn";
      renderMyList(status);
    }

    function openAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function syncRealAniListUser() {
      const username = document.getElementById('anilistUsernameInput').value.trim();
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('syncResultStatus');
      const syncBtn = document.getElementById('doSyncBtn');

      if (!username) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Please enter your AniList username';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetching from AniList...';
      syncBtn.disabled = true;

      const userListQuery = `
        query ($userName: String) {
          MediaListCollection(userName: $userName, type: ANIME) {
            lists {
              name
              status
              entries {
                status
                score
                media {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    extraLarge
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                  format
                  seasonYear
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const result = await queryAniList(userListQuery, { userName: username });
        if (result && result.MediaListCollection && result.MediaListCollection.lists) {
          const syncedItems = [];
          result.MediaListCollection.lists.forEach(list => {
            list.entries.forEach(entry => {
              syncedItems.push({
                id: entry.media.id,
                title: entry.media.title,
                coverImage: entry.media.coverImage,
                averageScore: entry.media.averageScore,
                format: entry.media.format,
                seasonYear: entry.media.seasonYear,
                status: entry.status || 'CURRENT'
              });
            });
          });

          myAnimeList = syncedItems;
          localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
          updateMyListBadge();

          document.getElementById('anilistBtnLabel').textContent = `@${username}`;
          statusEl.textContent = `✓ Synced ${syncedItems.length} anime from @${username}!`;
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');

          setTimeout(() => {
            closeAniListModal();
            syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
            syncBtn.disabled = false;
            statusEl.classList.add('hidden');
          }, 1800);
        } else {
          statusEl.textContent = 'User not found or list is private on AniList.';
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
          syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
          syncBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Failed to connect to AniList API.';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
        syncBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      initTheme();
      lucide.createIcons();
      updateMyListBadge();
      loadHomePageData();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

==================== CHUNK 52 (model) ====================
I have added **3D touch lift animations** and an **interactive quick-preview overlay** to all the anime cards!

---

### What Has Been Added:

1. **3D Card Lift & Spring Tilt**:
   - When you touch (on mobile) or hover over any anime card, it lifts up in 3D space (`translateY(-12px)`, `scale(1.04)`, `rotateX(4deg)`).
   - Casts a glowing rose shadow underneath with smooth spring physics.

2. **Interactive Quick-Preview Overlay**:
   - Lifting the card reveals a **Quick Preview window** directly on the card.
   - Shows the series title, genre pills, a **▶ Quick Play** button (starts playback immediately), and an **Info** button to view full details.

3. **Mobile-Optimized Touch**:
   - **First tap**: Lifts the card into 3D view and shows the quick preview.
   - **Second tap / Play button**: Opens the player / full details.
   - Tapping anywhere else smoothly drops the card back down.

---

```html
  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    const ANILIST_ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';
    let currentAnimeInModal = null;
    let myAnimeList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('anilove_mylist') || '[]');

    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('anilove_theme') || 'dark';
      if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !isDark);
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    async function queryAniList(query, variables) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(ANILIST_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.data;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('AniList API Error:', err);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const CATALOG_QUERY = `
      query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $sort: [MediaSort], $season: MediaSeason, $seasonYear: Int, $search: String, $genre: String) {
        Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
          media(type: ANIME, sort: $sort, season: $season, seasonYear: $seasonYear, search: $search, genre: $genre, isAdult: false) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
              native
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
              large
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            status
            episodes
            genres
            description
          }
        }
      }
    `;

    async function loadHomePageData() {
      const trendingData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['TRENDING_DESC']
      });
      if (trendingData && trendingData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('trendingGrid', trendingData.Page.media);
      }

      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const seasonalData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        season: 'SUMMER',
        seasonYear: currentYear,
        sort: ['POPULARITY_DESC']
      });
      if (seasonalData && seasonalData.Page.media) {
        document.getElementById('seasonHeading').textContent = `Airing in Summer ${currentYear}`;
        renderCardGrid('seasonalGrid', seasonalData.Page.media);
      }

      const topData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['SCORE_DESC']
      });
      if (topData && topData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('topRatedGrid', topData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    // 3D Interactive Card Render Function
    function renderCardGrid(elementId, animeList) {
      const container = document.getElementById(elementId);
      if (!container) return;

      if (!animeList || animeList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No series found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = animeList.map(anime => {
        const title = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Untitled';
        const score = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A';
        const year = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate ? anime.startDate.year : '2026');
        const format = anime.format || 'TV';
        const cover = anime.coverImage.large || anime.coverImage.extraLarge;
        const genres = (anime.genres || []).slice(0, 2).join(' • ');

        return `
          <div class="card-perspective-container">
            <div 
              tabindex="0"
              onclick="handleCardTouch(this, ${anime.id})"
              class="anime-3d-card group relative cursor-pointer flex flex-col space-y-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-dark-card border border-dark-border/80 p-1"
            >
              <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40">
                <img src="${cover}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" />
                
                <div class="rating-badge absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/70 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 border border-white/10 shadow-sm z-10">
                  <span class="text-yellow-400 font-normal">☆</span> ${score}
                </div>

                <!-- 3D Interactive Lifted Preview Overlay -->
                <div class="preview-overlay absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-dark-bg/95 via-dark-bg/60 to-black/30 p-3 flex flex-col justify-end text-left rounded-xl">
                  <div class="space-y-2">
                    <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-brand-600/90 text-white text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Quick Preview
                    </span>
                    <h4 class="text-xs font-extrabold text-white line-clamp-1 leading-tight">${title}</h4>
                    <p class="text-[10px] text-brand-400 font-medium line-clamp-1">${genres}</p>
                    
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                      <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); quickPlay(${anime.id});" class="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-md transition active:scale-95">
                        <i data-lucide="play" class="w-3 h-3 fill-white"></i> Play
                      </button>
                      <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openAnimeDetails(${anime.id});" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-dark-surface border border-dark-border text-slate-300 hover:text-white text-[11px] font-bold transition">
                        Info
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>

              <div class="px-1.5 pb-1 space-y-0.5">
                <h3 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-brand-500 transition">
                  ${title}
                </h3>
                <p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                  ${format} · ${year}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    let lastTouchedCard = null;
    function handleCardTouch(element, animeId) {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        if (lastTouchedCard && lastTouchedCard !== element) {
          lastTouchedCard.classList.remove('touch-active');
        }
        if (element.classList.contains('touch-active')) {
          openAnimeDetails(animeId);
        } else {
          element.classList.add('touch-active');
          lastTouchedCard = element;
        }
      } else {
        openAnimeDetails(animeId);
      }
    }

    function quickPlay(animeId) {
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
      setTimeout(() => {
        startVideoPlayback();
      }, 300);
    }

    function showTab(tabName) {
      document.getElementById('homeTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'home');
      document.getElementById('browseTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'browse');
      document.getElementById('myListTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'mylist');
      document.getElementById('heroSection').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName === 'mylist');

      const tabs = ['home', 'browse', 'mylist'];
      tabs.forEach(t => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`nav-${t}`);
        if (t === tabName) {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-dark-card border border-dark-border text-white font-semibold transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition";
        }
      });

      if (tabName === 'browse') {
        applyFilters();
      } else if (tabName === 'mylist') {
        renderMyList('all');
      }
    }

    async function triggerSearch() {
      const query = document.getElementById('heroSearchInput').value.trim();
      if (!query) return;
      showTab('browse');
      document.getElementById('browseTitle').textContent = `Search results for "${query}"`;
      
      const searchData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        search: query
      });

      if (searchData && searchData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', searchData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function applyFilters() {
      const genre = document.getElementById('genreFilter').value || undefined;
      const sort = [document.getElementById('sortFilter').value || 'POPULARITY_DESC'];

      const data = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        genre: genre,
        sort: sort
      });

      if (data && data.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', data.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function openAnimeDetails(animeId) {
      const query = `
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            status
            episodes
            genres
            description(asHtml: false)
          }
        }
      `;
      const res = await queryAniList(query, { id: animeId });
      if (!res || !res.Media) return;
      const anime = res.Media;
      currentAnimeInModal = anime;

      document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji;
      document.getElementById('detailScore').textContent = `☆ ${anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}`;
      document.getElementById('detailFormat').textContent = `${anime.format || 'TV'} • ${anime.seasonYear || '2026'}`;
      document.getElementById('detailStatus').textContent = anime.status || 'FINISHED';
      document.getElementById('detailGenres').textContent = (anime.genres || []).join(' • ');
      document.getElementById('detailSynopsis').textContent = anime.description ? anime.description.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '') : 'No synopsis available.';

      const banner = anime.bannerImage || anime.coverImage.extraLarge;
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').style.backgroundImage = `url('${banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer').pause();

      const found = myAnimeList.find(x => x.id === anime.id);
      document.getElementById('userStatusSelect').value = found ? found.status : 'UNTRACKED';

      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.remove('hidden');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function closeDetailModal() {
      document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.add('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.pause();
    }

    function startVideoPlayback() {
      document.getElementById('modalBannerImg').classList.add('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.src = "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4";
      vid.classList.remove('hidden');
      vid.play();

      const skipBtn = document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn');
      vid.ontimeupdate = () => {
        if (vid.currentTime >= 3 && vid.currentTime <= 25) {
          skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      };
    }

    function triggerAniSkip() {
      const vid = document.getElementById('modalVideoPlayer');
      vid.currentTime = 26;
      document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function updateWatchStatus(status) {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      myAnimeList = myAnimeList.filter(x => x.id !== currentAnimeInModal.id);
      if (status !== 'UNTRACKED') {
        myAnimeList.push({
          id: currentAnimeInModal.id,
          title: currentAnimeInModal.title,
          coverImage: currentAnimeInModal.coverImage,
          averageScore: currentAnimeInModal.averageScore,
          format: currentAnimeInModal.format,
          seasonYear: currentAnimeInModal.seasonYear,
          status: status
        });
      }
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
      updateMyListBadge();
    }

    function updateMyListBadge() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('myListBadge');
      if (myAnimeList.length > 0) {
        badge.textContent = myAnimeList.length;
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        badge.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    function renderMyList(filterStatus = 'all') {
      const container = document.getElementById('myListGrid');
      const list = filterStatus === 'all' ? myAnimeList : myAnimeList.filter(x => x.status === filterStatus);
      renderCardGrid('myListGrid', list);
    }

    function filterMyList(status) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.list-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-dark-card border border-dark-border text-slate-300 list-filter-btn";
      });
      document.getElementById(`lfb-${status}`).className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-brand-600 text-white font-semibold list-filter-btn";
      renderMyList(status);
    }

    function openAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function syncRealAniListUser() {
      const username = document.getElementById('anilistUsernameInput').value.trim();
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('syncResultStatus');
      const syncBtn = document.getElementById('doSyncBtn');

      if (!username) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Please enter your AniList username';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetching from AniList...';
      syncBtn.disabled = true;

      const userListQuery = `
        query ($userName: String) {
          MediaListCollection(userName: $userName, type: ANIME) {
            lists {
              name
              status
              entries {
                status
                score
                media {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    extraLarge
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                  format
                  seasonYear
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const result = await queryAniList(userListQuery, { userName: username });
        if (result && result.MediaListCollection && result.MediaListCollection.lists) {
          const syncedItems = [];
          result.MediaListCollection.lists.forEach(list => {
            list.entries.forEach(entry => {
              syncedItems.push({
                id: entry.media.id,
                title: entry.media.title,
                coverImage: entry.media.coverImage,
                averageScore: entry.media.averageScore,
                format: entry.media.format,
                seasonYear: entry.media.seasonYear,
                status: entry.status || 'CURRENT'
              });
            });
          });

          myAnimeList = syncedItems;
          localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
          updateMyListBadge();

          document.getElementById('anilistBtnLabel').textContent = `@${username}`;
          statusEl.textContent = `✓ Synced ${syncedItems.length} anime from @${username}!`;
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');

          setTimeout(() => {
            closeAniListModal();
            syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
            syncBtn.disabled = false;
            statusEl.classList.add('hidden');
          }, 1800);
        } else {
          statusEl.textContent = 'User not found or list is private on AniList.';
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
          syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
          syncBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Failed to connect to AniList API.';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
        syncBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      initTheme();
      lucide.createIcons();
      updateMyListBadge();
      loadHomePageData();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
