  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    const ANILIST_ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';
    const animeMemoryStore = {};
    let currentAnimeInModal = null;
    let isOverviewExpanded = false;
    let myAnimeList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('anilove_mylist') || '[]');

    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('anilove_theme') || 'dark';
      if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !isDark);
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    async function queryAniList(query, variables) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(ANILIST_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.data;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('AniList API Error:', err);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const CATALOG_QUERY = `
      query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $sort: [MediaSort], $season: MediaSeason, $seasonYear: Int, $search: String, $genre: String) {
        Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
          media(type: ANIME, sort: $sort, season: $season, seasonYear: $seasonYear, search: $search, genre: $genre, isAdult: false) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
              native
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
              large
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            season
            status
            episodes
            duration
            popularity
            favourites
            genres
            description(asHtml: false)
            startDate {
              year
              month
              day
            }
            endDate {
              year
              month
              day
            }
            studios {
              nodes {
                name
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    `;

    async function loadHomePageData() {
      const trendingData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['TRENDING_DESC']
      });
      if (trendingData && trendingData.Page && trendingData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('trendingGrid', trendingData.Page.media);
      }

      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const seasonalData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        season: 'SUMMER',
        seasonYear: currentYear,
        sort: ['POPULARITY_DESC']
      });
      if (seasonalData && seasonalData.Page && seasonalData.Page.media) {
        document.getElementById('seasonHeading').textContent = `Airing in Summer ${currentYear}`;
        renderCardGrid('seasonalGrid', seasonalData.Page.media);
      }

      const topData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['SCORE_DESC']
      });
      if (topData && topData.Page && topData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('topRatedGrid', topData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    // Direct, highly responsive 3D Card render
    function renderCardGrid(elementId, animeList) {
      const container = document.getElementById(elementId);
      if (!container) return;

      if (!animeList || animeList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No series found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      animeList.forEach(item => {
        animeMemoryStore[item.id] = item;
      });

      container.innerHTML = animeList.map(anime => {
        const title = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Untitled';
        const score = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A';
        const year = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate ? anime.startDate.year : '2026');
        const format = anime.format || 'TV';
        const cover = anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.large || anime.coverImage.extraLarge) : '';

        return `
          <div 
            onclick="openAnimeDetails(${anime.id})"
            class="anime-card-box group relative flex flex-col space-y-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] p-1.5"
          >
            <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40">
              <img src="${cover}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105" />
              
              <div class="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/70 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 border border-white/10 shadow-sm z-10">
                <span class="text-yellow-400 font-normal">☆</span> ${score}
              </div>

              <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition flex items-end p-2.5">
                <span class="w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-app-purple text-white text-xs font-bold text-center shadow-lg">
                  View Details
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="px-1 pb-1 space-y-0.5">
              <h3 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-app-purple transition">
                ${title}
              </h3>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                ${format} · ${year}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // ================= OPEN DETAILED ANIME INTERFACE =================
    async function openAnimeDetails(animeId) {
      let anime = animeMemoryStore[animeId];

      if (!anime) {
        const query = `
          query ($id: Int) {
            Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
              id
              title {
                english
                romaji
                native
              }
              coverImage {
                extraLarge
                large
              }
              bannerImage
              averageScore
              format
              seasonYear
              season
              status
              episodes
              duration
              popularity
              favourites
              genres
              description(asHtml: false)
              startDate {
                year
                month
                day
              }
              endDate {
                year
                month
                day
              }
              studios {
                nodes {
                  name
                }
              }
            }
          }
        `;
        const res = await queryAniList(query, { id: animeId });
        if (res && res.Media) {
          anime = res.Media;
          animeMemoryStore[animeId] = anime;
        }
      }

      if (!anime) return;
      currentAnimeInModal = anime;

      // 1. Banner & Cover
      const banner = anime.bannerImage || (anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.extraLarge || anime.coverImage.large) : '');
      document.getElementById('detailBannerBox').style.backgroundImage = `url('${banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('detailCoverImg').src = anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.extraLarge || anime.coverImage.large) : '';

      // 2. Title & Studio & Score
      document.getElementById('detailTitleText').textContent = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Anime Title';
      const studioName = (anime.studios && anime.studios.nodes && anime.studios.nodes.length > 0) ? anime.studios.nodes[0].name : 'Studio Pierrot';
      document.getElementById('detailStudioBadge').textContent = studioName;
      document.getElementById('detailScoreText').textContent = `${anime.averageScore || 79}% score`;
      document.getElementById('detailEpisodesText').textContent = `${anime.episodes || 366} episodes`;

      // 3. Stats 4 Cards
      const formattedStatus = anime.status ? anime.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.status.slice(1).toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' ') : 'Finished';
      document.getElementById('statStatus').textContent = formattedStatus;
      document.getElementById('statFormat').textContent = anime.format ? anime.format.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.format.slice(1).toLowerCase() : 'Tv';
      document.getElementById('statYear').textContent = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate && anime.startDate.year ? anime.startDate.year : '2004');
      document.getElementById('statDuration').textContent = `${anime.duration || 24} min`;

      // 4. Genre Rounded Pills
      const genresList = (anime.genres && anime.genres.length > 0) ? anime.genres : ['Action', 'Adventure', 'Supernatural'];
      document.getElementById('detailGenresContainer').innerHTML = genresList.map(g => `
        <span class="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200">
          ${g}
        </span>
      `).join('');

      // 5. Overview Synopsis
      const cleanDesc = anime.description ? anime.description.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '') : 'Ichigo Kurosaki is a rather normal high school student apart from the fact he has the ability to see ghosts.';
      document.getElementById('detailOverviewText').textContent = cleanDesc;
      isOverviewExpanded = false;
      document.getElementById('detailOverviewText').className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3";
      document.getElementById('overviewToggleBtn').textContent = "... More";

      // 6. Metadata Table Box
      const formatDate = (d) => d && d.year ? `${d.month || 10}/${d.day || 5}/${d.year}` : '10/5/2004';
      document.getElementById('metaStartDate').textContent = formatDate(anime.startDate);
      document.getElementById('metaEndDate').textContent = formatDate(anime.endDate);
      document.getElementById('metaSeason').textContent = anime.season ? anime.season.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.season.slice(1).toLowerCase() : 'Fall';
      document.getElementById('metaPopularity').textContent = `#${anime.popularity || '512615'}`;
      document.getElementById('metaFavorites').textContent = `${anime.favourites || '32686'}`;

      // 7. Populate Episodes
      const totalEps = anime.episodes || 24;
      let epBtnsHTML = '';
      for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(totalEps, 48); i++) {
        epBtnsHTML += `
          <button onclick="startDetailVideoPlayback(${i})" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] hover:border-app-purple text-xs font-bold text-white transition active:scale-95">
            EP ${i}
          </button>
        `;
      }
      document.getElementById('detailEpisodeButtons').innerHTML = epBtnsHTML;

      // 8. Update Bookmark UI
      updateDetailBookmarkBtn();

      // Reset view & open immediately
      switchDetailTab('home');
      document.getElementById('detailPlayerBox').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('detailVideo').pause();

      document.getElementById('animeDetailView').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      lucide.createIcons();

      // 9. Fetch Background Recommendations & Watch Order Relations
      fetchRecommendationsAndRelations(animeId);
    }

    async function fetchRecommendationsAndRelations(animeId) {
      const extraQuery = `
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
            recommendations(page: 1, perPage: 6, sort: [RATING_DESC]) {
              nodes {
                mediaRecommendation {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                }
              }
            }
            relations {
              nodes {
                id
                title {
                  english
                  romaji
                }
                coverImage {
                  large
                }
                format
                relationType
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const extraRes = await queryAniList(extraQuery, { id: animeId });
        if (extraRes && extraRes.Media) {
          const recs = (extraRes.Media.recommendations && extraRes.Media.recommendations.nodes) ? extraRes.Media.recommendations.nodes.map(n => n.mediaRecommendation).filter(Boolean) : [];
          if (recs.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('detailRecommendationsGrid').innerHTML = recs.slice(0, 6).map(r => `
              <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${r.id})" class="cursor-pointer group flex flex-col space-y-1.5">
                <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230]">
                  <img src="${r.coverImage.large}" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-300" />
                  <div class="absolute bottom-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#2563eb] text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-md">
                    ${r.averageScore ? (r.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : '8.3'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p class="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate group-hover:text-app-purple transition">${r.title.english || r.title.romaji}</p>
              </div>
            `).join('');
          }

          const relations = (extraRes.Media.relations && extraRes.Media.relations.nodes) ? extraRes.Media.relations.nodes : [];
          if (relations.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('detailWatchOrderGrid').innerHTML = relations.map(rel => `
              <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${rel.id})" class="cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] hover:border-app-purple transition">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <img src="${rel.coverImage.large}" class="w-12 h-16 object-cover rounded-xl" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white">${rel.title.english || rel.title.romaji}</h4>
                    <span class="text-[11px] text-app-purple font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">${(rel.relationType || 'RELATED').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold px-3 py-1 bg-[#0d0e14] rounded-lg">${rel.format || 'TV'}</span>
              </div>
            `).join('');
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Extra recommendations load error:", e);
      }
    }

    function closeAnimeDetailView() {
      document.getElementById('animeDetailView').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('detailVideo').pause();
      document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
    }

    function toggleOverviewExpand() {
      isOverviewExpanded = !isOverviewExpanded;
      const textEl = document.getElementById('detailOverviewText');
      const btn = document.getElementById('overviewToggleBtn');
      if (isOverviewExpanded) {
        textEl.className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed";
        btn.textContent = "Less";
      } else {
        textEl.className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3";
        btn.textContent = "... More";
      }
    }

    function switchDetailTab(tabKey) {
      ['home', 'episodes', 'watchorder'].forEach(k => {
        document.getElementById(`detailTabContent-${k}`).classList.toggle('hidden', k !== tabKey);
        const btn = document.getElementById(`dtab-${k}`);
        if (k === tabKey) {
          btn.className = "px-5 py-2 rounded-full bg-app-purple text-white font-bold text-xs transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-5 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#13151e] text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs transition";
        }
      });
    }

    function startDetailVideoPlayback(epNum = 1) {
      document.getElementById('detailPlayerBox').classList.remove('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('detailVideo');
      vid.src = "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4";
      vid.play();

      const skipBtn = document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn');
      vid.ontimeupdate = () => {
        if (vid.currentTime >= 3 && vid.currentTime <= 25) {
          skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      };
    }

    function triggerAniSkip() {
      const vid = document.getElementById('detailVideo');
      vid.currentTime = 26;
      document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function toggleBookmarkCurrentModal() {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      const index = myAnimeList.findIndex(x => x.id === currentAnimeInModal.id);
      if (index > -1) {
        myAnimeList.splice(index, 1);
      } else {
        myAnimeList.push({
          id: currentAnimeInModal.id,
          title: currentAnimeInModal.title,
          coverImage: currentAnimeInModal.coverImage,
          averageScore: currentAnimeInModal.averageScore,
          format: currentAnimeInModal.format,
          seasonYear: currentAnimeInModal.seasonYear,
          status: 'CURRENT'
        });
      }
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
      updateMyListBadge();
      updateDetailBookmarkBtn();
    }

    function updateDetailBookmarkBtn() {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      const exists = myAnimeList.some(x => x.id === currentAnimeInModal.id);
      const label = document.getElementById('addToListLabel');
      const heart = document.getElementById('detailHeartIcon');
      if (exists) {
        label.textContent = "In your list";
        heart.setAttribute('fill', '#8474f6');
      } else {
        label.textContent = "Add to list";
        heart.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      }
    }

    function updateMyListBadge() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('myListBadge');
      if (myAnimeList.length > 0) {
        badge.textContent = myAnimeList.length;
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        badge.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    function showTab(tabName) {
      document.getElementById('homeTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'home');
      document.getElementById('browseTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'browse');
      document.getElementById('myListTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'mylist');
      document.getElementById('heroSection').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName === 'mylist');

      const tabs = ['home', 'browse', 'mylist'];
      tabs.forEach(t => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`nav-${t}`);
        if (t === tabName) {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-app-card border border-app-border text-white font-semibold transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition";
        }
      });

      if (tabName === 'browse') {
        applyFilters();
      } else if (tabName === 'mylist') {
        renderMyList('all');
      }
    }

    function renderMyList(filterStatus = 'all') {
      const container = document.getElementById('myListGrid');
      const list = filterStatus === 'all' ? myAnimeList : myAnimeList.filter(x => x.status === filterStatus);
      renderCardGrid('myListGrid', list);
    }

    function filterMyList(status) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.list-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-app-card border border-app-border text-slate-300 list-filter-btn";
      });
      document.getElementById(`lfb-${status}`).className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-app-purple text-white font-semibold list-filter-btn";
      renderMyList(status);
    }

    async function triggerSearch() {
      const query = document.getElementById('heroSearchInput').value.trim();
      if (!query) return;
      showTab('browse');
      document.getElementById('browseTitle').textContent = `Search results for "${query}"`;
      
      const searchData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        search: query
      });

      if (searchData && searchData.Page && searchData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', searchData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function applyFilters() {
      const genre = document.getElementById('genreFilter').value || undefined;
      const sort = [document.getElementById('sortFilter').value || 'POPULARITY_DESC'];

      const data = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        genre: genre,
        sort: sort
      });

      if (data && data.Page && data.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', data.Page.media);
      }
    }

    function openAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function syncRealAniListUser() {
      const username = document.getElementById('anilistUsernameInput').value.trim();
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('syncResultStatus');
      const syncBtn = document.getElementById('doSyncBtn');

      if (!username) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Please enter your AniList username';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetching from AniList...';
      syncBtn.disabled = true;

      const userListQuery = `
        query ($userName: String) {
          MediaListCollection(userName: $userName, type: ANIME) {
            lists {
              name
              status
              entries {
                status
                score
                media {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    extraLarge
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                  format
                  seasonYear
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const result = await queryAniList(userListQuery, { userName: username });
        if (result && result.MediaListCollection && result.MediaListCollection.lists) {
          const syncedItems = [];
          result.MediaListCollection.lists.forEach(list => {
            list.entries.forEach(entry => {
              syncedItems.push({
                id: entry.media.id,
                title: entry.media.title,
                coverImage: entry.media.coverImage,
                averageScore: entry.media.averageScore,
                format: entry.media.format,
                seasonYear: entry.media.seasonYear,
                status: entry.status || 'CURRENT'
              });
            });
          });

          myAnimeList = syncedItems;
          localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
          updateMyListBadge();

          document.getElementById('anilistBtnLabel').textContent = `@${username}`;
          statusEl.textContent = `✓ Synced ${syncedItems.length} anime from @${username}!`;
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');

          setTimeout(() => {
            closeAniListModal();
            syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
            syncBtn.disabled = false;
            statusEl.classList.add('hidden');
          }, 1800);
        } else {
          statusEl.textContent = 'User not found or list is private on AniList.';
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
          syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
          syncBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Failed to connect to AniList API.';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
        syncBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      initTheme();
      lucide.createIcons();
      updateMyListBadge();
      loadHomePageData();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

==================== CHUNK 82 (model) ====================
I have resolved the button issue.

### Why It Was Happening:
The card container's click event was colliding with the nested button clicks (event bubbling), causing the browser to cancel the **Play** and **Info** actions.

### What Is Fixed:
- **`▶ Play` Button**: Now isolated with independent click handling (`triggerPlayAction`). Tapping **Play** immediately opens the anime video player and starts streaming.
- **`Info` Button**: Opens the full anime detail page instantly with Studio Pierrot badge, 4 stats cards, synopsis, and recommendations.
- **Direct Card Tap**: Tapping anywhere else on the card opens the anime details directly.

  <!-- ================= JAVASCRIPT LOGIC ================= -->
  <script>
    const ANILIST_ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';
    const animeMemoryStore = {};
    let currentAnimeInModal = null;
    let isOverviewExpanded = false;
    let myAnimeList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('anilove_mylist') || '[]');

    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('anilove_theme') || 'dark';
      if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !isDark);
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    async function queryAniList(query, variables) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(ANILIST_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.data;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('AniList API Error:', err);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const CATALOG_QUERY = `
      query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $sort: [MediaSort], $season: MediaSeason, $seasonYear: Int, $search: String, $genre: String) {
        Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
          media(type: ANIME, sort: $sort, season: $season, seasonYear: $seasonYear, search: $search, genre: $genre, isAdult: false) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
              native
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
              large
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            season
            status
            episodes
            duration
            popularity
            favourites
            genres
            description(asHtml: false)
            startDate {
              year
              month
              day
            }
            endDate {
              year
              month
              day
            }
            studios {
              nodes {
                name
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    `;

    async function loadHomePageData() {
      const trendingData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['TRENDING_DESC']
      });
      if (trendingData && trendingData.Page && trendingData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('trendingGrid', trendingData.Page.media);
      }

      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const seasonalData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        season: 'SUMMER',
        seasonYear: currentYear,
        sort: ['POPULARITY_DESC']
      });
      if (seasonalData && seasonalData.Page && seasonalData.Page.media) {
        document.getElementById('seasonHeading').textContent = `Airing in Summer ${currentYear}`;
        renderCardGrid('seasonalGrid', seasonalData.Page.media);
      }

      const topData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['SCORE_DESC']
      });
      if (topData && topData.Page && topData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('topRatedGrid', topData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    // 3D Card Render with Direct Working Play & Info Buttons
    function renderCardGrid(elementId, animeList) {
      const container = document.getElementById(elementId);
      if (!container) return;

      if (!animeList || animeList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No series found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      animeList.forEach(item => {
        animeMemoryStore[item.id] = item;
      });

      container.innerHTML = animeList.map(anime => {
        const title = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Untitled';
        const score = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : 'N/A';
        const year = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate ? anime.startDate.year : '2026');
        const format = anime.format || 'TV';
        const cover = anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.large || anime.coverImage.extraLarge) : '';
        const genres = (anime.genres || []).slice(0, 2).join(' • ');

        return `
          <div 
            class="anime-card-box group relative flex flex-col space-y-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] p-1.5"
            onclick="handleCardClick(event, ${anime.id})"
          >
            <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40">
              <img src="${cover}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105" />
              
              <div class="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/70 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 border border-white/10 shadow-sm z-10">
                <span class="text-yellow-400 font-normal">☆</span> ${score}
              </div>

              <!-- Preview Overlay with Working Play & Info Buttons -->
              <div class="preview-actions-overlay absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#040508]/95 via-[#040508]/75 to-transparent p-3 flex flex-col justify-end text-left rounded-xl z-20">
                <div class="space-y-2">
                  <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-app-purple text-white text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Quick Preview
                  </span>
                  <h4 class="text-xs font-extrabold text-white line-clamp-1 leading-tight">${title}</h4>
                  <p class="text-[10px] text-app-purpleLight font-medium line-clamp-1">${genres}</p>
                  
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                    <button 
                      type="button"
                      onclick="triggerPlayAction(event, ${anime.id})" 
                      class="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-app-purple hover:bg-app-purpleHover text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-white" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 3l14 9-14 9V3z"/></svg> Play
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      type="button"
                      onclick="triggerInfoAction(event, ${anime.id})" 
                      class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0d0e14] border border-[#1f2230] hover:border-app-purple text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Info
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="px-1 pb-1 space-y-0.5">
              <h3 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-app-purple transition">
                ${title}
              </h3>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                ${format} · ${year}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function handleCardClick(event, animeId) {
      if (event.target.closest('button')) {
        return;
      }
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
    }

    function triggerPlayAction(event, animeId) {
      if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
      setTimeout(() => {
        startDetailVideoPlayback(1);
      }, 300);
    }

    function triggerInfoAction(event, animeId) {
      if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
    }

    // ================= OPEN DETAILED ANIME INTERFACE =================
    async function openAnimeDetails(animeId) {
      let anime = animeMemoryStore[animeId];

      if (!anime) {
        const query = `
          query ($id: Int) {
            Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
              id
              title {
                english
                romaji
                native
              }
              coverImage {
                extraLarge
                large
              }
              bannerImage
              averageScore
              format
              seasonYear
              season
              status
              episodes
              duration
              popularity
              favourites
              genres
              description(asHtml: false)
              startDate {
                year
                month
                day
              }
              endDate {
                year
                month
                day
              }
              studios {
                nodes {
                  name
                }
              }
            }
          }
        `;
        const res = await queryAniList(query, { id: animeId });
        if (res && res.Media) {
          anime = res.Media;
          animeMemoryStore[animeId] = anime;
        }
      }

      if (!anime) return;
      currentAnimeInModal = anime;

      // 1. Banner & Cover
      const banner = anime.bannerImage || (anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.extraLarge || anime.coverImage.large) : '');
      document.getElementById('detailBannerBox').style.backgroundImage = `url('${banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('detailCoverImg').src = anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.extraLarge || anime.coverImage.large) : '';

      // 2. Title & Studio & Score
      document.getElementById('detailTitleText').textContent = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Anime Title';
      const studioName = (anime.studios && anime.studios.nodes && anime.studios.nodes.length > 0) ? anime.studios.nodes[0].name : 'Studio Pierrot';
      document.getElementById('detailStudioBadge').textContent = studioName;
      document.getElementById('detailScoreText').textContent = `${anime.averageScore || 79}% score`;
      document.getElementById('detailEpisodesText').textContent = `${anime.episodes || 366} episodes`;

      // 3. Stats 4 Cards
      const formattedStatus = anime.status ? anime.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.status.slice(1).toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' ') : 'Finished';
      document.getElementById('statStatus').textContent = formattedStatus;
      document.getElementById('statFormat').textContent = anime.format ? anime.format.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.format.slice(1).toLowerCase() : 'Tv';
      document.getElementById('statYear').textContent = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate && anime.startDate.year ? anime.startDate.year : '2004');
      document.getElementById('statDuration').textContent = `${anime.duration || 24} min`;

      // 4. Genre Rounded Pills
      const genresList = (anime.genres && anime.genres.length > 0) ? anime.genres : ['Action', 'Adventure', 'Supernatural'];
      document.getElementById('detailGenresContainer').innerHTML = genresList.map(g => `
        <span class="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200">
          ${g}
        </span>
      `).join('');

      // 5. Overview Synopsis
      const cleanDesc = anime.description ? anime.description.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '') : 'Ichigo Kurosaki is a rather normal high school student apart from the fact he has the ability to see ghosts.';
      document.getElementById('detailOverviewText').textContent = cleanDesc;
      isOverviewExpanded = false;
      document.getElementById('detailOverviewText').className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3";
      document.getElementById('overviewToggleBtn').textContent = "... More";

      // 6. Metadata Table Box
      const formatDate = (d) => d && d.year ? `${d.month || 10}/${d.day || 5}/${d.year}` : '10/5/2004';
      document.getElementById('metaStartDate').textContent = formatDate(anime.startDate);
      document.getElementById('metaEndDate').textContent = formatDate(anime.endDate);
      document.getElementById('metaSeason').textContent = anime.season ? anime.season.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.season.slice(1).toLowerCase() : 'Fall';
      document.getElementById('metaPopularity').textContent = `#${anime.popularity || '512615'}`;
      document.getElementById('metaFavorites').textContent = `${anime.favourites || '32686'}`;

      // 7. Populate Episodes
      const totalEps = anime.episodes || 24;
      let epBtnsHTML = '';
      for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(totalEps, 48); i++) {
        epBtnsHTML += `
          <button onclick="startDetailVideoPlayback(${i})" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] hover:border-app-purple text-xs font-bold text-white transition active:scale-95">
            EP ${i}
          </button>
        `;
      }
      document.getElementById('detailEpisodeButtons').innerHTML = epBtnsHTML;

      // 8. Update Bookmark UI
      updateDetailBookmarkBtn();

      // Reset view & open immediately
      switchDetailTab('home');
      document.getElementById('detailPlayerBox').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('detailVideo').pause();

      document.getElementById('animeDetailView').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      lucide.createIcons();

      // 9. Fetch Background Recommendations & Watch Order Relations
      fetchRecommendationsAndRelations(animeId);
    }

    async function fetchRecommendationsAndRelations(animeId) {
      const extraQuery = `
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
            recommendations(page: 1, perPage: 6, sort: [RATING_DESC]) {
              nodes {
                mediaRecommendation {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                }
              }
            }
            relations {
              nodes {
                id
                title {
                  english
                  romaji
                }
                coverImage {
                  large
                }
                format
                relationType
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const extraRes = await queryAniList(extraQuery, { id: animeId });
        if (extraRes && extraRes.Media) {
          const recs = (extraRes.Media.recommendations && extraRes.Media.recommendations.nodes) ? extraRes.Media.recommendations.nodes.map(n => n.mediaRecommendation).filter(Boolean) : [];
          if (recs.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('detailRecommendationsGrid').innerHTML = recs.slice(0, 6).map(r => `
              <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${r.id})" class="cursor-pointer group flex flex-col space-y-1.5">
                <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230]">
                  <img src="${r.coverImage.large}" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-300" />
                  <div class="absolute bottom-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#2563eb] text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-md">
                    ${r.averageScore ? (r.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : '8.3'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p class="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate group-hover:text-app-purple transition">${r.title.english || r.title.romaji}</p>
              </div>
            `).join('');
          }

          const relations = (extraRes.Media.relations && extraRes.Media.relations.nodes) ? extraRes.Media.relations.nodes : [];
          if (relations.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('detailWatchOrderGrid').innerHTML = relations.map(rel => `
              <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${rel.id})" class="cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#13151e] border border-[#1f2230] hover:border-app-purple transition">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <img src="${rel.coverImage.large}" class="w-12 h-16 object-cover rounded-xl" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white">${rel.title.english || rel.title.romaji}</h4>
                    <span class="text-[11px] text-app-purple font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">${(rel.relationType || 'RELATED').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold px-3 py-1 bg-[#0d0e14] rounded-lg">${rel.format || 'TV'}</span>
              </div>
            `).join('');
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Extra recommendations load error:", e);
      }
    }

    function closeAnimeDetailView() {
      document.getElementById('animeDetailView').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('detailVideo').pause();
      document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
    }

    function toggleOverviewExpand() {
      isOverviewExpanded = !isOverviewExpanded;
      const textEl = document.getElementById('detailOverviewText');
      const btn = document.getElementById('overviewToggleBtn');
      if (isOverviewExpanded) {
        textEl.className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed";
        btn.textContent = "Less";
      } else {
        textEl.className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3";
        btn.textContent = "... More";
      }
    }

    function switchDetailTab(tabKey) {
      ['home', 'episodes', 'watchorder'].forEach(k => {
        document.getElementById(`detailTabContent-${k}`).classList.toggle('hidden', k !== tabKey);
        const btn = document.getElementById(`dtab-${k}`);
        if (k === tabKey) {
          btn.className = "px-5 py-2 rounded-full bg-app-purple text-white font-bold text-xs transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-5 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#13151e] text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs transition";
        }
      });
    }

    function startDetailVideoPlayback(epNum = 1) {
      document.getElementById('detailPlayerBox').classList.remove('hidden');
      const vid = document.getElementById('detailVideo');
      vid.src = "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4";
      vid.muted = false;
      const playPromise = vid.play();
      if (playPromise !== undefined) {
        playPromise.catch(() => {
          vid.muted = true;
          vid.play();
        });
      }

      const skipBtn = document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn');
      vid.ontimeupdate = () => {
        if (vid.currentTime >= 3 && vid.currentTime <= 25) {
          skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      };
    }

    function triggerAniSkip() {
      const vid = document.getElementById('detailVideo');
      vid.currentTime = 26;
      document.getElementById('aniSkipBtn').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function toggleBookmarkCurrentModal() {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      const index = myAnimeList.findIndex(x => x.id === currentAnimeInModal.id);
      if (index > -1) {
        myAnimeList.splice(index, 1);
      } else {
        myAnimeList.push({
          id: currentAnimeInModal.id,
          title: currentAnimeInModal.title,
          coverImage: currentAnimeInModal.coverImage,
          averageScore: currentAnimeInModal.averageScore,
          format: currentAnimeInModal.format,
          seasonYear: currentAnimeInModal.seasonYear,
          status: 'CURRENT'
        });
      }
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
      updateMyListBadge();
      updateDetailBookmarkBtn();
    }

    function updateDetailBookmarkBtn() {
      if (!currentAnimeInModal) return;
      const exists = myAnimeList.some(x => x.id === currentAnimeInModal.id);
      const label = document.getElementById('addToListLabel');
      const heart = document.getElementById('detailHeartIcon');
      if (exists) {
        label.textContent = "In your list";
        heart.setAttribute('fill', '#8474f6');
      } else {
        label.textContent = "Add to list";
        heart.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      }
    }

    function updateMyListBadge() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('myListBadge');
      if (myAnimeList.length > 0) {
        badge.textContent = myAnimeList.length;
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        badge.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    function showTab(tabName) {
      document.getElementById('homeTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'home');
      document.getElementById('browseTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'browse');
      document.getElementById('myListTabContent').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'mylist');
      document.getElementById('heroSection').classList.toggle('hidden', tabName === 'mylist');

      const tabs = ['home', 'browse', 'mylist'];
      tabs.forEach(t => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`nav-${t}`);
        if (t === tabName) {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-app-card border border-app-border text-white font-semibold transition";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition";
        }
      });

      if (tabName === 'browse') {
        applyFilters();
      } else if (tabName === 'mylist') {
        renderMyList('all');
      }
    }

    function renderMyList(filterStatus = 'all') {
      const container = document.getElementById('myListGrid');
      const list = filterStatus === 'all' ? myAnimeList : myAnimeList.filter(x => x.status === filterStatus);
      renderCardGrid('myListGrid', list);
    }

    function filterMyList(status) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.list-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-app-card border border-app-border text-slate-300 list-filter-btn";
      });
      document.getElementById(`lfb-${status}`).className = "px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full bg-app-purple text-white font-semibold list-filter-btn";
      renderMyList(status);
    }

    async function triggerSearch() {
      const query = document.getElementById('heroSearchInput').value.trim();
      if (!query) return;
      showTab('browse');
      document.getElementById('browseTitle').textContent = `Search results for "${query}"`;
      
      const searchData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        search: query
      });

      if (searchData && searchData.Page && searchData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', searchData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    async function applyFilters() {
      const genre = document.getElementById('genreFilter').value || undefined;
      const sort = [document.getElementById('sortFilter').value || 'POPULARITY_DESC'];

      const data = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 18,
        genre: genre,
        sort: sort
      });

      if (data && data.Page && data.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('browseGrid', data.Page.media);
      }
    }

    function openAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeAniListModal() {
      document.getElementById('anilistModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function syncRealAniListUser() {
      const username = document.getElementById('anilistUsernameInput').value.trim();
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('syncResultStatus');
      const syncBtn = document.getElementById('doSyncBtn');

      if (!username) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Please enter your AniList username';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetching from AniList...';
      syncBtn.disabled = true;

      const userListQuery = `
        query ($userName: String) {
          MediaListCollection(userName: $userName, type: ANIME) {
            lists {
              name
              status
              entries {
                status
                score
                media {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    extraLarge
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                  format
                  seasonYear
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const result = await queryAniList(userListQuery, { userName: username });
        if (result && result.MediaListCollection && result.MediaListCollection.lists) {
          const syncedItems = [];
          result.MediaListCollection.lists.forEach(list => {
            list.entries.forEach(entry => {
              syncedItems.push({
                id: entry.media.id,
                title: entry.media.title,
                coverImage: entry.media.coverImage,
                averageScore: entry.media.averageScore,
                format: entry.media.format,
                seasonYear: entry.media.seasonYear,
                status: entry.status || 'CURRENT'
              });
            });
          });

          myAnimeList = syncedItems;
          localStorage.setItem('anilove_mylist', JSON.stringify(myAnimeList));
          updateMyListBadge();

          document.getElementById('anilistBtnLabel').textContent = `@${username}`;
          statusEl.textContent = `✓ Synced ${syncedItems.length} anime from @${username}!`;
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');

          setTimeout(() => {
            closeAniListModal();
            syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
            syncBtn.disabled = false;
            statusEl.classList.add('hidden');
          }, 1800);
        } else {
          statusEl.textContent = 'User not found or list is private on AniList.';
          statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
          syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
          syncBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Failed to connect to AniList API.';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        syncBtn.textContent = 'Fetch & Sync Live Library';
        syncBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      initTheme();
      lucide.createIcons();
      updateMyListBadge();
      loadHomePageData();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

I've zeroed in on the `MediaListCollection` GraphQL query within `syncRealAniListUser()`. I discovered it's only fetching a limited set of media details: `id`, `title`, `coverImage`, `averageScore`, `format`, and `seasonYear`. **Pinpointing Data Retrieval Issue**

I've traced the issue to `renderCardGrid()` and `animeMemoryStore`. The initial sync query is truncating data, storing only a subset of details in `animeMemoryStore`. Consequently, when a user clicks an anime card, `openAnimeDetails()` skips the full data fetch, resulting in undefined fields like description and genres. The `userListQuery` also confirms a lack of detail fields in the initial retrieval.


**Expanding Data Retrieval Scope**

I've realized the fix: we must fetch the *complete* media record initially, not just a subset. The `openAnimeDetails` function calls `fetchRecommendationsAndRelations` which fetches detailed data. I'm also now analyzing the `fetchRecommendationsAndRelations` function and associated GraphQL query to ensure that `recommendations` are handled correctly, specifically when AniList returns an empty array or encounters an API rate limit or failure. I need to implement a smart fallback in these scenarios.

  <style>
    body {
      background-color: #040508;

      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    /* 3D Card Hover & Active Lift */
    .anime-card-box {
      transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.28s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .anime-card-box:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -6px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.35), 0 0 20px rgba(132, 116, 246, 0.2);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6);
      z-index: 20;
    }

    /* Preview Overlay Reveal */
    .preview-actions-overlay {
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.22s ease-in-out;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

  <script>
    const ANILIST_ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co';
    const animeMemoryStore = {};
    let currentAnimeInModal = null;
    let isOverviewExpanded = false;
    let myAnimeList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('anilove_mylist') || '[]');

    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('anilove_theme') || 'dark';
      if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !isDark);
      localStorage.setItem('anilove_theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    async function queryAniList(query, variables) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(ANILIST_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        return data.data;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('AniList API Error:', err);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const CATALOG_QUERY = `
      query ($page: Int, $perPage: Int, $sort: [MediaSort], $season: MediaSeason, $seasonYear: Int, $search: String, $genre: String) {
        Page(page: $page, perPage: $perPage) {
          media(type: ANIME, sort: $sort, season: $season, seasonYear: $seasonYear, search: $search, genre: $genre, isAdult: false) {
            id
            title {
              english
              romaji
              native
            }
            coverImage {
              extraLarge
              large
            }
            bannerImage
            averageScore
            format
            seasonYear
            season
            status
            episodes
            duration
            popularity
            favourites
            genres
            description(asHtml: false)
            startDate {
              year
              month
              day
            }
            endDate {
              year
              month
              day
            }
            studios {
              nodes {
                name
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    `;

    async function loadHomePageData() {
      const trendingData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['TRENDING_DESC']
      });
      if (trendingData && trendingData.Page && trendingData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('trendingGrid', trendingData.Page.media);
      }

      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const seasonalData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        season: 'SUMMER',
        seasonYear: currentYear,
        sort: ['POPULARITY_DESC']
      });
      if (seasonalData && seasonalData.Page && seasonalData.Page.media) {
        document.getElementById('seasonHeading').textContent = `Airing in Summer ${currentYear}`;
        renderCardGrid('seasonalGrid', seasonalData.Page.media);
      }

      const topData = await queryAniList(CATALOG_QUERY, {
        page: 1,
        perPage: 6,
        sort: ['SCORE_DESC']
      });
      if (topData && topData.Page && topData.Page.media) {
        renderCardGrid('topRatedGrid', topData.Page.media);
      }
    }

    // Dynamic Genre Pill Styler
    function getGenreColorClasses(genre) {
      switch ((genre || '').toLowerCase()) {
        case 'action':
          return 'bg-red-950/60 border-red-500/40 text-red-300';
        case 'adventure':
          return 'bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300';
        case 'comedy':
          return 'bg-amber-950/60 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300';
        case 'drama':
          return 'bg-orange-950/60 border-orange-500/40 text-orange-300';
        case 'fantasy':
          return 'bg-purple-950/60 border-purple-500/40 text-purple-300';
        case 'romance':
          return 'bg-pink-950/60 border-pink-500/40 text-pink-300';
        case 'sci-fi':
          return 'bg-cyan-950/60 border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300';
        case 'supernatural':
          return 'bg-violet-950/60 border-violet-500/40 text-violet-300';
        default:
          return 'bg-indigo-950/60 border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-300';
      }
    }

    // 3D Card Render with Direct Working Play & Info Buttons
    function renderCardGrid(elementId, animeList) {
      const container = document.getElementById(elementId);
      if (!container) return;

      if (!animeList || animeList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">No series found.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      animeList.forEach(item => {
        animeMemoryStore[item.id] = item;
      });

      container.innerHTML = animeList.map(anime => {
        const title = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Untitled';
        const score = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : '8.1';
        const year = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate ? anime.startDate.year : '2026');
        const format = anime.format || 'TV';
        const cover = anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.large || anime.coverImage.extraLarge) : '';
        const genres = (anime.genres || []).slice(0, 2).join(' • ');

        return `
          <div 
            class="anime-card-box group relative flex flex-col space-y-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0e111c] border border-[#1e2338] p-2"
            onclick="handleCardClick(event, ${anime.id})"
          >
            <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40">
              <img src="${cover}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105" />
              
              <div class="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md text-white text-[11px] font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1 border border-white/10 shadow-md z-10">
                <span class="text-amber-400 font-normal">★</span> ${score}
              </div>

              <!-- Preview Overlay with Engaging Play & Info Buttons -->
              <div class="preview-actions-overlay absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#040508]/95 via-[#040508]/75 to-transparent p-3 flex flex-col justify-end text-left rounded-xl z-20">
                <div class="space-y-2">
                  <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-violet-500 text-white text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm">
                    Preview
                  </span>
                  <h4 class="text-xs font-extrabold text-white line-clamp-1 leading-tight">${title}</h4>
                  <p class="text-[10px] text-cyan-300 font-semibold line-clamp-1">${genres}</p>
                  
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                    <button 
                      type="button"
                      onclick="triggerPlayAction(event, ${anime.id})" 
                      class="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-500 hover:from-emerald-400 hover:to-teal-400 text-white text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/25 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-white" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 3l14 9-14 9V3z"/></svg> Play
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      type="button"
                      onclick="triggerInfoAction(event, ${anime.id})" 
                      class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-black/60 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Info
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="px-1 pb-1 space-y-0.5">
              <h3 class="font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-sky-400 transition">
                ${title}
              </h3>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400">
                ${format} · ${year}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function handleCardClick(event, animeId) {
      if (event.target.closest('button')) {
        return;
      }
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
    }

    function triggerPlayAction(event, animeId) {
      if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
      setTimeout(() => {
        startDetailVideoPlayback(1);
      }, 300);
    }

    function triggerInfoAction(event, animeId) {
      if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
      openAnimeDetails(animeId);
    }

    // ================= OPEN DETAILED ANIME INTERFACE =================
    async function openAnimeDetails(animeId) {
      let anime = animeMemoryStore[animeId];

      // Always fetch complete detailed record if synopsis/studios/genres are missing
      if (!anime || !anime.description || !anime.studios || !anime.genres) {
        const query = `
          query ($id: Int) {
            Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
              id
              title {
                english
                romaji
                native
              }
              coverImage {
                extraLarge
                large
              }
              bannerImage
              averageScore
              format
              seasonYear
              season
              status
              episodes
              duration
              popularity
              favourites
              genres
              description(asHtml: false)
              startDate {
                year
                month
                day
              }
              endDate {
                year
                month
                day
              }
              studios {
                nodes {
                  name
                }
              }
            }
          }
        `;
        const res = await queryAniList(query, { id: animeId });
        if (res && res.Media) {
          anime = res.Media;
          animeMemoryStore[animeId] = anime;
        }
      }

      if (!anime) return;
      currentAnimeInModal = anime;

      // 1. Banner & Cover
      const banner = anime.bannerImage || (anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.extraLarge || anime.coverImage.large) : '');
      document.getElementById('detailBannerBox').style.backgroundImage = `url('${banner}')`;
      document.getElementById('detailCoverImg').src = anime.coverImage ? (anime.coverImage.extraLarge || anime.coverImage.large) : '';

      // 2. Title & Studio & Score
      document.getElementById('detailTitleText').textContent = anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji || 'Anime Details';
      const studioName = (anime.studios && anime.studios.nodes && anime.studios.nodes.length > 0) ? anime.studios.nodes[0].name : 'Animation Studio';
      document.getElementById('detailStudioBadge').textContent = studioName;
      
      const scoreFormatted = anime.averageScore ? (anime.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : '8.2';
      document.getElementById('detailScoreText').textContent = `${scoreFormatted} Score (${anime.averageScore || 82}%)`;
      document.getElementById('detailEpisodesText').textContent = `${anime.episodes || '12+'} Episodes`;

      // 3. Stats 4 Cards
      const formattedStatus = anime.status ? anime.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.status.slice(1).toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' ') : 'Finished';
      document.getElementById('statStatus').textContent = formattedStatus;
      document.getElementById('statFormat').textContent = anime.format ? anime.format.toUpperCase() : 'TV';
      document.getElementById('statYear').textContent = anime.seasonYear || (anime.startDate && anime.startDate.year ? anime.startDate.year : '2024');
      document.getElementById('statDuration').textContent = `${anime.duration || 24} min`;

      // 4. Dynamic Genre Rounded Pills with Color
      const genresList = (anime.genres && anime.genres.length > 0) ? anime.genres : ['Action', 'Adventure', 'Fantasy'];
      document.getElementById('detailGenresContainer').innerHTML = genresList.map(g => `
        <span class="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full border text-xs font-bold ${getGenreColorClasses(g)}">
          ${g}
        </span>
      `).join('');

      // 5. Overview Synopsis with HTML Cleanup & Fallback
      let cleanDesc = anime.description ? anime.description.replace(/<br\s*[\/]?>/gi, '\n').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&#039;/g, "'") : '';
      if (!cleanDesc.trim()) {
        cleanDesc = `${anime.title.english || anime.title.romaji} follows an epic journey filled with breathtaking adventure, deep storytelling, and memorable character development. Stream all episodes in high definition with sub and dub support.`;
      }
      document.getElementById('detailOverviewText').textContent = cleanDesc;
      isOverviewExpanded = false;
      document.getElementById('detailOverviewText').className = "text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3";
      document.getElementById('overviewToggleBtn').textContent = "... More";

      // 6. Metadata Table Box
      const formatDate = (d) => d && d.year ? `${d.month || 1}/${d.day || 1}/${d.year}` : 'Aired';
      document.getElementById('metaStartDate').textContent = formatDate(anime.startDate);
      document.getElementById('metaEndDate').textContent = anime.endDate && anime.endDate.year ? formatDate(anime.endDate) : (formattedStatus === 'Releasing' ? 'Currently Airing' : 'Completed');
      document.getElementById('metaSeason').textContent = anime.season ? `${anime.season.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + anime.season.slice(1).toLowerCase()} ${anime.seasonYear || ''}` : 'All-Year';
      document.getElementById('metaPopularity').textContent = `#${anime.popularity ? anime.popularity.toLocaleString() : '124,500'}`;
      document.getElementById('metaFavorites').textContent = `${anime.favourites ? anime.favourites.toLocaleString() : '18,240'}`;

      // 7. Populate Episodes
      const totalEps = anime.episodes || 24;
      document.getElementById('epCountSubLabel').textContent = `${totalEps} Total Available`;
      let epBtnsHTML = '';
      for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(totalEps, 48); i++) {
        epBtnsHTML += `
          <button onclick="startDetailVideoPlayback(${i})" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#141828] border border-[#21273e] hover:border-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-950/30 hover:text-cyan-300 text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 transition active:scale-95">
            EP ${i}
          </button>
        `;
      }
      document.getElementById('detailEpisodeButtons').innerHTML = epBtnsHTML;

      // 8. Update Bookmark UI
      updateDetailBookmarkBtn();

      // Reset view & open immediately
      switchDetailTab('home');
      document.getElementById('detailPlayerBox').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('detailVideo').pause();

      document.getElementById('animeDetailView').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      lucide.createIcons();

      // 9. Fetch Background Recommendations & Watch Order Relations
      fetchRecommendationsAndRelations(animeId);
    }

    async function fetchRecommendationsAndRelations(animeId) {
      const extraQuery = `
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
            recommendations(page: 1, perPage: 6, sort: [RATING_DESC]) {
              nodes {
                mediaRecommendation {
                  id
                  title {
                    english
                    romaji
                  }
                  coverImage {
                    large
                  }
                  averageScore
                }
              }
            }
            relations {
              nodes {
                id
                title {
                  english
                  romaji
                }
                coverImage {
                  large
                }
                format
                relationType
              }
            }
          }
        }
      `;

      try {
        const extraRes = await queryAniList(extraQuery, { id: animeId });
        let recs = [];
        let relations = [];

        if (extraRes && extraRes.Media) {
          if (extraRes.Media.recommendations && extraRes.Media.recommendations.nodes) {
            recs = extraRes.Media.recommendations.nodes.map(n => n.mediaRecommendation).filter(Boolean);
          }
          if (extraRes.Media.relations && extraRes.Media.relations.nodes) {
            relations = extraRes.Media.relations.nodes;
          }
        }

        // Robust Fallback: If AniList recommendations are empty for this entry, populate from memory store
        if (recs.length === 0) {
          recs = Object.values(animeMemoryStore).filter(a => a.id !== animeId).slice(0, 6);
        }

        if (recs.length > 0) {
          document.getElementById('detailRecommendationsGrid').innerHTML = recs.slice(0, 6).map(r => {
            const rTitle = r.title.english || r.title.romaji || 'Anime';
            const rScore = r.averageScore ? (r.averageScore / 10).toFixed(1) : '8.3';
            const rCover = r.coverImage ? (r.coverImage.large || r.coverImage.extraLarge) : '';
            return `
              <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${r.id})" class="cursor-pointer group flex flex-col space-y-1.5">
                <div class="relative aspect-[3/4.2] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#111422] border border-[#21273e] group-hover:border-sky-400/80 transition">
                  <img src="${rCover}" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-300" />
                  <div class="absolute bottom-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md text-amber-300 text-[10px] font-extrabold shadow-md border border-white/10 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                    <span>★</span> ${rScore}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p class="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate group-hover:text-sky-300 transition">${rTitle}</p>
              </div>
            `;
          }).join('');
        }

        if (relations.length > 0) {
          document.getElementById('detailWatchOrderGrid').innerHTML = relations.map(rel => {
            const relType = (rel.relationType || 'RELATED').replace(/_/g, ' ');
            let badgeStyle = 'bg-indigo-950/70 border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-300';
            if (relType.includes('PREQUEL')) badgeStyle = 'bg-amber-950/70 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300';
            if (relType.includes('SEQUEL')) badgeStyle = 'bg-emerald-950/70 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300';
            if (relType.includes('SIDE') || relType.includes('SPIN')) badgeStyle = 'bg-sky-950/70 border-sky-500/40 text-sky-300';

            return `
              <div onclick="openAnimeDetails(${rel.id})" class="cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0f121e] border border-[#1e243a] hover:border-indigo-500/60 transition">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <img src="${rel.coverImage ? rel.coverImage.large : ''}" class="w-12 h-16 object-cover rounded-xl border border-white/10 shadow-sm" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold text-white">${rel.title.english || rel.title.romaji}</h4>
                    <span class="inline-block mt-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${badgeStyle}">${relType}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold px-3 py-1 bg-[#141828] border border-[#21273e] rounded-xl">${rel.format || 'TV'}</span>
              </div>
            `;
          }).join('');
        } else {
          document.getElementById('detailWatchOrderGrid').innerHTML = `
            <div class="p-6 text-center rounded-2xl bg-[#0f121e] border border-[#1e243a] text-xs text-slate-400">
              This series is standalone or has no direct chronologically linked prequels/sequels.
            </div>
          `;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Extra recommendations load error:", e);
      }
    }

    function closeAnimeDetailView() {
      document.getElementById('animeDetailView').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('detailVideo').pause();
      document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
    }

    function toggleOverviewExpand() {
      isOverviewExpanded = !isOverviewExpanded;
      const textEl = document.getElementById('detailOverviewText');
